heard: NASA flew to Jupiter just to look at the Sun, leaving the Sun behind was actually the only way to see it. Standard rockets are trapped in the solar system's flat plane. Only Jupiter's gravity could slingshot a probe over the Sun's poles. Ulysses launched in 1990 to perform that impossible turn. The probe even accidentally sailed through three different cometails. Then it revealed polar winds screaming twice as fast as the equator. It remains the only mission sent to Jupiter just to look at the Sun.
